SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '01ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD != '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '01ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD = '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bEndCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '02ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD != '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '02ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD = '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fEndCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '03ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD != '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '03ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD = '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wEndCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '04ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD != '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iGoCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = '04ISSUESTAT' AND PRIORITY_CD = '04ISSUEPRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iEndCount
FROM issue WHERE prj_id = #{prjId}
